abstract: Abstract Analyzing professional forecasts, I find that a model of expectation formation in which respondents misperceive the law of motion of the data generating process, which in turn causes them to form an erroneous view of its underlying persistence, outperforms alternative models when fit to forecast errors and revisions. Misspecified expectations, which outperforms the alternatives in and out of sample and for a variety of macro‐economic variables, is successful in part because it allows forecast errors to be longer lived. I conclude that misspecified expectations can serve as a suitable way of modeling expectation formation among professional forecasters.
abstract_zh: 摘要 通过分析专业预测，我发现一种预期形成模型——其中受访者误解了数据生成过程的运动规律，进而导致他们对潜在持续性形成错误认识——在拟合预测误差和修正时优于其他模型。这种错误设定的预期在样本内外及多种宏观经济变量中均表现更佳，其成功部分归因于允许预测误差具有更长的持续性。我得出结论，错误设定的预期可作为模拟专业预测者预期形成的合适方法。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Misspecified Expectations among Professional Forecasters
title_zh: 专业预测者的错误设定预期

abstract: This paper considers precautionary saving against the correlation between two risky attributes (wealth and health) and investigates how the correlation affects optimal savings under multivariate preferences. The signs of higher‐order cross‐derivatives play a key role in determining the direction of precautionary saving against such correlation. Mixed correlation‐averse (seeking) individuals increase (decrease) savings in response to increases in correlation. Furthermore, we introduce ambiguity to the correlation and investigate how ambiguity affects the amount of optimal savings. The analyses enable us to deepen our understanding of saving behavior under multivariate preferences in the presence of correlation.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了针对财富与健康两种风险属性之间相关性的预防性储蓄行为，并研究了在多维偏好下，这种相关性如何影响最优储蓄水平。高阶交叉导数的符号在决定针对此类相关性的预防性储蓄方向上起着关键作用。混合相关性厌恶（偏好）型个体在面对相关性增强时会增加（减少）储蓄。此外，我们将模糊性引入相关性分析，并考察模糊性如何影响最优储蓄量。这些分析有助于深化我们对存在相关性时多维偏好下储蓄行为的理解。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Precautionary Saving against Correlation under Risk and Ambiguity
title_zh: 风险与模糊性下针对相关性的预防性储蓄

abstract: Public programs that provide financial compensation for voluntary behavior have been widely used to incentivize the conservation of common property resources such as groundwater. Numerous existing groundwater conservation programs provide financial incentives to agricultural producers to permanently retire their groundwater use rights, ceasing irrigation from the associated well. This research estimates the net social benefits of a retirement policy and compares them to net benefits realized under a policy that provides subsidies for incremental reductions in groundwater use. Policies aimed at incremental groundwater use reductions have historically been ignored due, in part, to technological limitations for monitoring water use. Technological advancements make policies based on incremental changes in behavior feasible. We develop a theoretical model to compare water use behavior and welfare under the alternative policies. Then, we use a novel integrated assessment model to empirically illustrate the dynamic economic tradeoffs of the policies for a study area in Kansas. Our analysis shows that resource rents actually decrease under the retirement program relative to a baseline with no conservation policy. Further, subsidizing incremental reductions in groundwater use can dramatically increase the net social benefits of groundwater conservation relative to the retirement policy, but the choice of the subsidy policy parameters plays a critical role in determining its impact and cost to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 为自愿行为提供经济补偿的公共项目已被广泛用于激励地下水等共有财产资源的保护。众多现有的地下水保护项目向农业生产者提供经济激励，以永久放弃其地下水使用权，停止相关水井的灌溉。本研究评估了退出政策的净社会效益，并将其与对地下水使用增量减少提供补贴的政策所实现的净效益进行比较。历史上，针对地下水使用增量减少的政策常被忽视，部分原因在于监测用水量的技术限制。技术进步使得基于行为增量变化的政策变得可行。我们构建了一个理论模型，以比较不同政策下的用水行为和社会福利。随后，我们采用一种新颖的综合评估模型，实证展示了堪萨斯州研究区域内政策的动态经济权衡。我们的分析表明，与无保护政策的基准情景相比，退出项目下的资源租金实际上有所下降。此外，与退出政策相比，补贴地下水使用的增量减少可以显著提高地下水保护的净社会效益，但补贴政策参数的选择对其影响及政策制定者的成本起着关键作用。
title: Abatement subsidies for groundwater conservation
title_zh: 地下水保护的减排补贴
